title: Reader share is available for missing EPUB files

evidence.quote:
EinkReaderView(
                    articles: orderedArticles,
                    epubFilePath: digest.epubFilePath,
                    remoteDigestId: digest.remoteId
                )

if digest.remoteId != nil, !epubAvailable {
                    Text("EPUB not downloaded")

reasoning: History computes that a completed remote digest may not have a local EPUB, and even displays 'EPUB not downloaded', but the row still navigates to DigestDetailView. DigestDetailView then passes the non-optional string path into EinkReaderView, and EinkReaderView shows ShareLink whenever the string is non-nil rather than when the file exists. Users can therefore try to share a non-existent EPUB from the reader.
reproduction: Sync a completed remote digest whose EPUB has not been downloaded or whose local file was removed, tap the row in History, then use the reader share button.
recommendation: Gate the reader share button on FileManager.fileExists(atPath:) or pass an explicit epubAvailable/localFileURL value from History/DigestDetailView. Consider disabling navigation or showing a download action when the digest has no local EPUB and no article content.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The screenshot test opens the first fixture digest and only checks that the Back button appears; it does not assert share availability for missing files or the 'EPUB not downloaded' state.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a UI or view-model-level test with a completed remote digest whose epubFilePath points to a missing file and assert the reader does not expose ShareLink for that URL.
minimumFixScope: EinkReaderView share condition and, if needed, DigestDetailView/HistoryView data passed to it.
